verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://vercel.com/openapi.json returns HTTP 200 with an "openapi" key. Vercel's llms.txt explicitly links the REST API OpenAPI description (openapi.vercel.sh) and tells agents to read it before calling operations. The ai-catalog probe also lists the Vercel REST API as a machine-readable resource, backed by documented REST API and access-token docs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the spec is complete and accurate.
